Column2: Hey mate.
Column2 SCH: 朋友。
Column4: Sigh...
Column4 SCH: *叹气*
Column5: Huh?!
Column6: Fancy seeing you here.
Column6 SCH: 没想到你会来。
Column7: Howdy, whippersnapper!
Column7 SCH: 唷，年轻人！
Column8: Oh?
Column8 SCH: 喔？
Column9: Oy!
Column9 SCH: 喂！
Column10: Yo!
Column10 SCH: 唷！
Column11: G-greetings.
Column11 SCH: 欢、欢迎光临。
Column12: Aye!
Column12 SCH: 嘿！
Column13: Hmph.
Column13 SCH: 哼。

Column2: Cheers!
Column2 SCH: 再见！
Column3: Do you mind?
Column3 SCH: 你介意吗？
Column4: I'll just be here...
Column4 SCH: 我就在这儿，哪儿都不去……
Column5: Yeah! Okay! Great! Good!
Column5 SCH: 嗯！好的！棒极了！好啊！
Column6: Love watching you walk away.
Column6 SCH: 喜欢看你走出去的样子。
Column7: You be careful now!
Column7 SCH: 小心点儿！
Column8: Sorry, who were you again?
Column8 SCH: 对不起，你叫什么来着？
Column9: Say hi to my twin!
Column9 SCH: 替我跟小陆打个招呼！
Column10: Tell my twin I said hi.
Column10 SCH: 跟小陆问个好。
Column11: G-g-goodbye.
Column11 SCH: 再、再、再见。
Column12: Carry on!
Column12 SCH: 去吧！
Column13: Now go away.
Column13 SCH: 行了，走吧。

Column2: Welcome, I'm Theo! How have things been so far? Looks like you're doing great. The more time you spend with the locals, I'm sure the more they'll like you.
Column2 SCH: 欢迎光临，我叫提奥！工作顺利吗？看样子你干得不错。你跟本地住户接触越多，他们肯定就会越喜欢你。
Column3: You seem familiar… do I know you? I'm Cici. What's REALLY in these deliveries? I ought to check, but that's exactly what they'd want me to do...
Column3 SCH: 看你有点眼熟……我是不是认识你？我叫茜茜。这些包裹是什么东西？我需要看一下，可他们恰恰就希望我这样……
Column4: I'm Fortino, not that it matters... Can you keep a secret? I don't even care. I'm hopelessly in love with Ellie at the Bakery... But they don't even know I exist.
Column4 SCH: 我叫阿肆，你可能也不在乎……告诉你件事，能帮我保密吗？不能也无所谓。我爱上了面包店的艾丽，每天满脑子都是她……可她都不知道有我这么个家伙。
Column5: I'm Ellie. Who are you?! They call me the crazy one. Ever taken a bite out of one of those packages? Can't say I haven't. Do you think they should teach dolphins how to read?
Column5 SCH: 我叫艾丽，你是谁？！他们说我脑筋不正常。尝过这些包裹里的东西吗？我是没尝过。你觉得他们该教海豚看书吗？
Column6: I heard we had a different delivery driver, but I didn't know you'd be so handsome! You can call me Fit. Or call me the love of your life, it's really your choice.
Column6 SCH: 我听说快递司机换了，没想到换了个这么帅的！可以叫我菲特，也可以叫我“你深爱的猫”，随你。
Column7: Jeepers, you look like the spitting image of Seb. The spitting image, I say. But no one listens to old Tooey. Don't let them work you too hard.
Column7 SCH: 好家伙，活脱脱一个塞巴啊！要我说，一模一样。不过，谁都不听我图伊的。给他们干活可以，可别把自己累坏咯。
Column8: Hey, Seb! It's me, Reed! I saw you just the other day! Wait, you're not Seb. Man, I keep forgetting things. Who were you again?
Column8 SCH: 塞巴！是我，李德啊！我那天还看见你了！等下，你不是塞巴。啊呀，瞧我这个记性。你叫什么来着？
Column9: I heard you're new! I'm Fives! Did you meet my twin Sixo yet? If Sixo asks you if you want to make some money, just run away.
Column9 SCH: 听说你是新来的！我是阿伍！见到我双胞胎弟弟小陆没有？要是他问你想不想赚钱，什么都不要回答，转头就跑。
Column10: New delivery guy! I'm Sixo! Listen, I have an investment opportunity that'll knock your socks off. Just let me think of it.
Column10 SCH: 新来的快递员！我叫小陆！我跟你说，我有个绝对好、好上天的投资机遇。让我想一下。
Column11: S-Seb? Oh, no, n-new guy. I g-guess you're d-doing d- d-deliveries now. I'm A-A-Ada. I'm not t-talking very w-well these days.
Column11 SCH: 塞、塞巴？噢不是，新、新来的，来拿、拿花的吧。我叫阿、阿、阿达，这、这几天说、说话不、不、不太利索。
Column12: You know how tae drive, snapper? Call me Foreman. What I wouldnae give fer a day out fishing. No one to bother me.
Column12 SCH: 小家伙，你知道咋开车？叫我佛尔曼。我要能出去钓一天鱼，让我干啥都行，清净，没猫烦我。
Column13: Welcome to EasyFuel, I'm Gus. I only sell fuel. Have a terrible day. That'll be $price
Column13 SCH: 欢迎光临顺易加油站，我叫古斯。这边不卖别的，只加油。祝你工作不顺心。$price

Column2: I seem to have dropped the feminist literature I was just reading, any chance you've seen it around?
Column2 SCH: 我刚才在看一本女性主义文学，好像弄丢了，你看见没有？
Column3: I've done my own research on these deliveries and have determined that they definitely contain something suspicious, like "cardboard".
Column3 SCH: 我研究了这些货物，确定里面肯定存在可疑物品，比如说“纸板”。
Column4: I'm hopelessly in love with Ellie, but they don't even see me... Surely it's not because I hide behind a building whenever I see them.
Column4 SCH: 我爱上了艾丽，满心都是她，可她根本看不到我……肯定不是因为我每次都是躲在楼房后面偷偷看她。
Column5: Have you spoken to Fortino, that sad guy, recently? Every time I see them they run away and hide.
Column5 SCH: 阿肆那个家伙动不动就很犹豫，最近见过他没有？我每次看见他，他都会跑开躲起来。
Column6: You can deliver my package any day, if you know what I mean. Get it, because you're the delivery driver?
Column6 SCH: 我的货你哪天来去都行，明白我什么意思吧？你应该明白，毕竟是快递司机。
Column7: Don't say much, do you, lad? That's alright, old Foreman at the Pizzeria will talk enough for the both of you. Save some Co2 for the rest of us, I say.
Column7 SCH: 小伙子不大爱说话啊？没事儿，披萨店的老佛尔曼话多，都替你说了。这样也好，能给我们少排一点二氧化碳。
Column8: Seb spoke so much more than you do, eh? You're not really a talker. Also, remind me, I have to remember to tell you something! I've forgotten already.
Column8 SCH: 塞巴的话可比你多多了呵？看你是不怎么爱说话。另外，我有什么事情要跟你说的来着！这就想不起来了……
Column9: I saw you speaking with MK the other day. MK and Seb used to be inseparable, I hope they're doing okay. Bit mysterious, that guy.
Column9 SCH: 我那天看见你跟MK说话。MK和塞巴以前是形影不离的好朋友。希望他还好，那家伙有点神秘。
Column10: Hear me out. Imagine a machine could do what you're doing, but somehow worse, with a larger margin of error. And it costs decades of environmental decline.
Column10 SCH: 麻烦耐心听我说完。想象有一种机器也可以送快递，只是效率低，出错率高，而且造成了数十年的环境恶化。
Column11: N-nice to s-see you again. It's b-b-been a while since I've s-s-spoken to some-some-someone n-new. S-such a nice s-soul.
Column11 SCH: 又、又来啦。有、有、有些日子没怎、怎么见过新面、面孔了。你、你真、真好。
Column12: When you see old Tooey again, give 'em a dead-eyed stare for me, would ye? Heh-heh.
Column12 SCH: 下次再见到老图伊，可不可以替我死死地盯他一回？嘿嘿。
Column13: Whatever they're paying you, I'll pay you slightly less to go away. That'll be $price
Column13 SCH: 我不管他们打发你的时候给你多少小费，我给的只会比他们稍微少一点，$price

Column2: I like to start my day with a simple 17km jog, followed by three hours of meditation. You should try it sometime!
Column2 SCH: 我喜欢每天先简简单单慢跑17公里，然后冥想三个小时。你有机会可以试一试！
Column3: The birds... They run away when I approach them. They know I'm onto them. I don't think they're real.
Column3 SCH: 那些鸟……我一凑过去，他们就飞走了。他们知道我想抓他们，我觉得他们是假鸟。
Column4: I couldn't find any flowers… Do you think a pile of dirt makes a good gift?
Column4 SCH: 什么花都买不到……你说一捧土适合当礼物吗？
Column5: You know, I always find myself in need of some dirt. And I can never find any! Then one day it just started showing up! Like dirt from heaven!
Column5 SCH: 你知道吗，我成天需要土，可怎么都找不到！然后有一天，土就自己冒出来了！像天上掉下来的一样！
Column6: Every once in a while, I wonder whether I should be flirting with everyone I meet. But then I remember everyone I meet is incredibly attractive.
Column6 SCH: 我隔三差五就会想，自己到底该不该见了谁都要逗两下，只是很快就会想起来实在是因为我见到的猫都太有魅力了。
Column7: In the old days, there were such beautiful colours on the mountainside. When I moved in here, almost everyone was already gone. Seems like just yesterday.
Column7 SCH: 早年间，山坡这边漂亮极了，五颜六色的。我搬过来的时候，住户就已经走得差不多了。说着感觉就跟昨天似的。
Column8: Hey, not-Seb guy. See, I'm remembering! I'd put some more air in those tires if I were you. Actually nevermind, we're all out of air.
Column8 SCH: 嘿，不是塞巴的家伙。看，我没忘你是谁！建议你给轮胎补补气。其实无所谓了，我们也没有气了。
Column9: Sometimes, I try to talk to the birds. They ignore me every time. Must have been personal.
Column9 SCH: 我有时候会想办法跟鸟说话，可它们从来不理我，肯定是对我有意见。
Column10: I have a huge business idea for you. Picture a vending machine that sold other vending machines. Great, eh?
Column10 SCH: 告诉你个能发大财的点子。想象一下，假如一台自动贩卖机能卖自动贩卖机，那不是会卖疯了？
Column11: Who are w-we to ask anything m-more of life than t-time and warmth? And y-yet we always n-need more of b-b-both.
Column11 SCH: 除、除了时间、间和温、温暖，我们凭、凭什么还对生、生活有其他的期、期、期待？可、可我们偏、偏总是觉得这、这两样都不够。
Column12: How come EasyCo gave ye a right-hand drive truck? Better yet, how come they let ye drive at all? You drive like a goose gained sentience and lost its morals.
Column12 SCH: 顺易集团怎么给了你一辆右舵的卡车？而且，他们怎么会让你开车？你开车就像有了感知能力但没了道德的鹅一样。
Column13: Exactly who I wanted to see! To prove that there is no such thing as a benevolent God. Give me $price
Column13 SCH: 你都不知道我有多想看到你！哎……上帝真的是不遂猫愿。给我$price

Column2: Almost didn't notice you, I've been so deep in thought about the injustices of the world.
Column2 SCH: 差点没注意到你，刚才在沉思这个世界上的种种不公。
Column3: Those twins are always talking about each other, but have you ever seen them together? I think there's three of them.
Column3 SCH: 那对双胞胎成天说多么多么想对方，可你见过他们待在一起吗？我觉得他们还有个兄弟，是三胞胎。
Column4: I saw Ellie today... Maybe I'll say hello soon... Give me 17 months or so. What if we don't instantly fall in love forever? You should say hello for me.
Column4 SCH: 今天见到艾丽了……我过段时间就去跟她打招呼……再让我准备17个月。假如我们见了之后，没能立刻坠入爱河，或者不能白头到老怎么办？你应该替我去跟她问个好。
Column5: I caught Fortino trying to deliver me dirt! What a perfect little sweetie! What a wonderful, sweet sound when they spoke. How listening to someone you love soothes your ears.
Column5 SCH: 阿肆想送我土，被我发现了！他真的是太有心了！声音也好听，听自己心爱的猫说话，耳朵就像做了按摩一样舒服。
Column6: If we were binary code, I'd be a 0, because you're the only 1 I need. That's how binary works, right?
Column6 SCH: 假如我们是二进制数字，那我就是0，因为你就是我的唯1。然后我们两个就能在一起2了。二进制是这样的吧？
Column7: Have you ever seen a sunset, lad? Most remarkable beauty you've ever seen. Here and then gone in an instant. Kind of like us.
Column7 SCH: 小伙子见过日落没有？那个景致，绝对超过你见过的任何风景。一眨眼的工夫，就消失了，有点像我们的生活。
Column8: I remember Seb was talking about retiring. But they would still come up here every day with MK, just to visit. Made me feel special, you know.
Column8 SCH: 我想起来塞巴之前说要退休，不过每天还是会跟MK一起过来看看，让我感觉非常荣幸。
Column9: Having nothing in the world but dreary weather and trees empties your soul. But maybe it's not so empty when you know a few people in it.
Column9 SCH: 如果你在这个世界只能体验沉闷的天气和那些树，那你的心灵就会空虚。如果你能认识几个朋友，也许就没那么空虚了。
Column10: The people in town are getting together more often. More people to pitch my self-deleting spam email idea to!
Column10 SCH: 村里的大家最近聚得越来越勤了。正好有更多猫能听我推销“自己删除自己的垃圾邮件”的那个点子了！
Column11: H-have an Easier day with EasyPredict! What you w-w-want, as soon as you want it! Have... S-sorry, I don't know w-what came over m-me. Old h-h-habits.
Column11 SCH: 顺心物流让、让您生活更、更加顺心！想、想要什么，立刻就能拿到！有……不、不好意思，我也不、不知道自己这是怎么了，老、老毛病。
Column12: Cold wind out there, guppy. Do me a favour and close Tooey's door next time yer there.
Column12 SCH: 小东西，外面风那么冷，小鱼。下次去图伊那儿的时候，帮我把他的门关上。
Column13: Surely this will have no environmental impact. I'd go over there and untie your shoes, but you're not worth the effort. That's $price
Column13 SCH: 这个肯定不会影响环境。换了平时，我肯定会过去把你鞋带解开，不过你不值得我费那个劲。$price

Column2: I've been training myself to eliminate chlorofluorocarbons from the air I breathe... So that I can begin to repair the ozone layer.
Column2 SCH: 我一直在训练自己，想消除自己呼吸的空气里的某些化学成分……这样就能开始修复臭氧层了。
Column3: I think those radio towers are beaming secret messages directly into our brains. Every time I change the channel on the radio, the music changes! Awfully suspicious.
Column3 SCH: 我觉得那些无线电塔在直接向我们大脑发送秘密信息。我每次换台，音乐都会变！太可疑了。
Column4: I DID IT, I DID IT!!! I spoke to Ellie! I don't know how it happened, I must have short-circuited! I'm not sure they even heard me, I ran away immediately.
Column4 SCH: 成功了，我做到了！！！我跟艾丽说话了！我也不知道怎么回事，肯定是我脑子短路了！不知道她听没听见我说话，我当时说完就跑了。
Column5: I've just had the most beautiful of days. I feel things I've never felt before, like a flutter of elephants in my heart. Elephants are the pretty bugs with colourful wings, right?
Column5 SCH: 我今天特别幸福，体会到了从未有过的感觉，就像一群大象在我心里扑扇翅膀。大象就是那种翅膀五颜六色的漂亮虫子吧？
Column6: If you ever get a break from this job, the locals have started meeting at Sixo's place. It feels good to have friends. And people to flirt with.
Column6 SCH: 本地住户最近经常去小陆家见面，你哪天要是休息，也可以过去。我就喜欢交朋友，也喜欢逗猫。
Column7: When you arrived, lad, it felt like just yesterday that Seb was doing deliveries. But I'm too old for that to be true. I suspect it's been much longer than we all think.
Column7 SCH: 孩子，你刚来的时候，我感觉就好像头一天塞巴还在这边送快递一样。不过，我年纪大了，记性不好。你到的时候，他应该早就不在了。
Column8: Every time I see you in that truck, I think it's Seb. Seb told me something the last time I saw them, but I still can't remember. I miss them.
Column8 SCH: 我每次看到你开那辆卡车，都会以为是塞巴。上次见塞巴的时候，他跟我说了什么事情，我到现在还没想起来。我想他。
Column9: Maybe I'm too hard on Sixo... Maybe life is all about supporting the people you love. Can't expect anything in return.
Column9 SCH: 我可能对小陆要求太多了……生活或许就是支持你爱的猫，什么回报都不求。
Column10: Here's a million dollar idea. Individually wrapped cookies that have ambiguous notes inside! I'll call them Fate Cookies! Sounds similar to something that already exists? I don't think so.
Column10 SCH: 我有个价值百万的金点子。饼干独立包装，然后每包都有一张神秘兮兮的小纸条！叫“命运饼干”吧！已经有这种东西了？没有吧。
Column11: I m-m-met new friends yesterday at the c-coffee shop. They are s-so accepting of m-me. K-kind. S-so many n-new friends.
Column11 SCH: 我昨、昨天在咖、咖啡店交了几个新朋友，他们都特、特别愿意跟我说、说话，特别、别好。好、好、好多新朋友。
Column12: Now that the minnows all gather and talk, callin themselves some sortae friends, I've got no time to meself. But isn't it a wee bit sweet to bum around with old Tooey.
Column12 SCH: 现在这帮小鱼小虾成天凑在一起聊天，说他们是什么朋友，弄得我也没办法自己清净了。不过能见到老图伊，也挺有意思。
Column13: If EasyCo offered mental health service benefits, I'd tell my therapist about you. You're lucky they don't offer benefits at all. That's $price
Column13 SCH: 假如顺易集团有心理健康方面的福利，我肯定会跟咨询师提你这个家伙。你要庆幸公司没有心理健康的福利。$price

Column2: If you have time on Friday night, I host a book club at Sixo's. I'm the only one who knows it's a book club, but it's wonderful to just spend time with my new friends.
Column2 SCH: 假如你周五晚上有空，我在小陆家办了个读书会，可以来。只有我知道到时候办的是读书会，不过能认识新朋友就很棒了。
Column3: Perhaps it's not worth my time living in fear of everything. Admitting that good things exist means I accept bad things can happen, even to good people.
Column3 SCH: 可能不该成天怕这怕那。我要想承认世上存在好事，就要明白坏事也可能发生，甚至是发生在好猫身上。
Column4: I spoke to Ellie for hours yesterday. I've never feared the future before, because I had nothing to look forward to. Now that I do, I'm a little afraid. But I've decided that the unknown is what makes life exciting.
Column4 SCH: 昨天跟艾丽聊了好几个小时。我之前从来不害怕未来，因为没什么可期待的。现在有期待的事情了，反而有点害怕了。不过我已经懂了，生活就是因为存在未知，才会这么精彩。
Column5: I could speak to Fortino for a hundred hours. That's how many are in a month. I could talk to Fortino for thirteen months! That's how many are in a week!
Column5 SCH: 我可以跟阿肆聊一百个小时。一个月差不多就有一百个小时。我可以跟阿肆聊十三个月！一周差不多就是十三个月！
Column6: Maybe I'm being too forward again, not that I'm known for that or anything... But it is so great to have real friends. You're my friend! There, I said it.
Column6 SCH: 我倒也不是这样的猫，不过这次可能又太主动了……可我真的很喜欢交到真朋友。你是我的朋友！我认真的。
Column7: In the early days, there were so many of us. But we never talked to each other. Maybe it's better we're fewer now. This little family feels closer together since you and Seb started.

Column5: Are you also always vibrating with infinite energy, so strong you can't feel your hands? Or is it just me? Wait! Where are my hands?!
Column5 SCH: 你是不是也总因为体内无穷的能量而振动，振到连自己的手都感觉不到了？还是说只有我这样？等等！我的手呢？！
Column6: You remind me of a rose. Kind of pointy and also red. If red was, you know, a different colour.
Column6 SCH: 我看着你，想起了一枝玫瑰。有刺，也是红的，前提是红色是，就是，另一种颜色。
Column7: I'd lift those packages myself, but my back isn't what it used to be.
Column7 SCH: 我是想自己搬那些包裹，可我这个腰已经不如当年了。
Column8: It's been so much fun to finally spend time with all the other residents over coffee. I didn't know it was so easy to make friends! Too bad none of them have trucks to fix.
Column8 SCH: 终于能和其他住户喝咖啡聊天了，真的太开心了。我都不知道交朋友这么简单！可惜他们没有卡车需要修理。
Column9: Zow! That's something my twin says, but it sounds ridiculous. However, I'll support even their dumbest goals.
Column9 SCH: 呀喔！小陆爱说这个，听着傻不拉几。就算这样，不论他的想法再怎么可笑，我都会支持。
Column10: Every time EasyCo tells me to have an Easy day, I do! That means it's always important to listen to what corporations tell you.
Column10 SCH: 每次顺易集团说祝我工作顺心，我都会照做！这就说明不论什么时候，我们都有必要听公司的话。
Column11: D-d-do you s-see the deer around? B-been a long time since I've s-seen one.
Column11 SCH: 你、你、你在、在附近看见过鹿吗？我、我好久没、没见过了。
Column12: Make sure yer extra slow pickin up anything from old Tooey, pike. And make sure tae drive way under the speed limit. That'll show 'em. Heh-heh.
Column12 SCH: 小家伙，去老图伊那边取货的时候动作不要那么快。车速也是能多慢就多慢。给他点颜色瞧瞧，嘿嘿。
Column13: Thinking about world domination. Not for me, I'd say. For now. Your total is $price
Column13 SCH: 在想统治世界的事情，不是我通知，暂时不是。总共$price。

Column2: What a journey life is, eh? You could even say it's a highway.
Column2 SCH: 生活真是一场旅程啊？甚至可以说是一条高速公路。
Column3: I used to be so suspicious of the weather being bad all the time. Turns out, all I needed to do was invest in a few nice sweaters.
Column3 SCH: 我以前经常抱怨天气总是这么糟糕。结果发现，当时其实只要买几件好毛衣就好了。
Column4: Do you spend your days thinking about someone you love? How does anyone think about anything else?
Column4 SCH: 你会整天想自己心爱的猫吗？哪里还有心思别的事情？
Column5: Weeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee.
Column6: Are you dark matter? Because there's something absolutely undetectable between us.
Column6 SCH: 你是暗物质吗？因为我们之间绝对有种无法探测的东西。
Column7: Ah, that was a good nap. Time for another.
Column7 SCH: 啊，睡了个好觉，该再睡一觉了。
Column8: Didn't I see you in the EasyMart earlier? That's a LOT of soup to buy for one person. Not you?
Column8 SCH: 我是不是在顺易超市见过你？一个猫买了那么多汤。不是你？
Column9: I made the mistake of betting Sixo wouldn't drink ten EZ-Energy drinks.
Column9 SCH: 我打赌小陆喝不了十罐顺易能量饮料，结果我赌错了。
Column10: Want to make some money? Have you heard of feet?
Column10 SCH: 想赚钱吗？听说过脚这个东西吗？
Column11: B-bird seed m-makes me happy. I am n-not allowed to g-give you some for f-free, but I w-would if I could.
Column11 SCH: 鸟、鸟食让、让我开心。我、我不可以免、免费给你，可、可我愿意给、给你。
Column12: Next time you see Tooey, snapper, donnae say anything. Tooey will know it's from me.
Column12 SCH: 年轻人，下次见图伊，啥都不用说。他就知道是我让你去的。
Column13: Hypothetically, if you were to take over the world, what would you do first? For no reason. $price
Column13 SCH: 假设，只是假设，如果你要统治世界了，第一件事会做什么？没别的意思，随便问问。$price

Column2: Nature is healing. Sort of.
Column2 SCH: 大自然正在恢复，算是恢复吧。
Column3: Seems like just a moment ago I saw you last... Is what I would say if I wasn't so happy to see you!
Column3 SCH: 感觉我好像刚刚才见过你一样……我除非不想看见你，不然肯定不会说那种话！
Column4: Everyone should fall deep in love at least once. When you love someone, it is so easy to consider how your actions affect others.
Column4 SCH: 每个猫都应该至少有过一次深爱。你爱上一个猫时，就更容易想到自己的行为会怎样影响其他猫。
Column5: I love that I get to share all of my thoughts with someone who listens to me so intently! I have more thoughts than I thought I did!
Column5 SCH: 如果一个猫愿意这么专心听我说，我就特别喜欢跟他分享我的所有想法！我都没想到自己有这么多想法！
Column6: You're a hard worker. I don't know why I haven't told you that before. I'm observing things in a new light these days.
Column6 SCH: 你干活很努力，不知道为什么以前没跟你说过。我现在换了一种视角看待事物。
Column7: Oh! My back.
Column7 SCH: 啊呀！我的腰。
Column8: Soup guy. I remember. Wait! No. Anyway, I can't change your oil today, I'm all out of mops.
Column8 SCH: 买汤的那个，我记得你。等等！不对。今天没法给你换机油了，我拖把用完了。
Column9: Am I wrong for thinking you shouldn't spend money on something you can't see? What on earth is a "dividend option"?
Column9 SCH: 我觉得就不该把钱花在看不见摸不着的东西上，这有什么错吗？“股息期权”到底是什么鬼？
Column10: I have consumed more energy drinks than the limit listed on the can. For some reason, the limit is zero?
Column10 SCH: 能量饮料罐子上标了健康摄入量，而我喝的超过了这个界限。不知道为什么，上面写的健康摄入量是零？
Column11: T-trees and ice. Trees a-and ice. Nothing in the world b-but trees a-and ice,
Column11 SCH: 树、树和冰，树和、和冰。这个世界除、除了树，就、就是冰。
Column12: Aye, what I wouldnae give fer a day out fishing. No one to bother me.
Column12 SCH: 我要能出去钓一天鱼，让我干啥都行，清净，没猫烦我。
Column13: So I think I've cracked how we'll take over the world. We're doing it together, by the way. You'll do all the work. That's $price
Column13 SCH: 我觉得自己已经知道怎样可以统治世界了。我们合作着来，所有活交给你。总共$price

Column2: You've gotten so good at this! I love giving compliments.
Column2 SCH: 你越来越厉害了！我喜欢夸赞别的猫。
Column3: Let's just say... I wouldn't ask me what I was doing earlier, if I were you.
Column3 SCH: 我只能说……我要是你的话，就不会问我刚才在干什么。
Column4: When we first met, I had no friends and no one who loved me. Now I have so many friends and I'm more loved than I've ever been.
Column4 SCH: 我们刚认识的时候，我没有朋友，也没猫爱我。现在我有很多朋友，也比以往更受大家喜爱。
Column5: Did you know that "capybara" in German is "wasserschwein"? That just means water pig! Write that down.
Column5 SCH: 你知道德语的“水豚”是“wasserschwein”吗？字面意义的“水猪”！快记下来。
Column6: You have remarkable lifting form. If you were a forklift, I'd get forklift certified.
Column6 SCH: 你搬重物的姿势简直完美。假如你是叉车的话，我肯定会去考个叉车证。
Column7: They don't make 'em like they used to, eh?
Column7 SCH: 他们现在做的东西是不是不如以前了？
Column8: You were so great in our hockey game last night. Never seen a goal like that from a guy with no arms. Wait, that wasn't you?
Column8 SCH: 你昨晚曲棍球比赛表现太棒了。第一次看见没胳膊还能打进那样的球。等等，那个家伙不是你？
Column9: What's life without a little risk? That's what I would say if I was stupid.
Column9 SCH: 生活没有一点小风险，还算什么生活？我除非蠢，不然不会说那种话。
Column10: Cici and I are getting in on the ground floor of the next big thing. Cici won't tell me what it is, but I believe them wholeheartedly.
Column10 SCH: 茜茜带着我在准备一件大事。她不愿意告诉我具体是什么事情，但我全心全意相信她。
Column11: I am b-beginning to t-think about the th-th-things I sell here. W-what is it all f-for? Do the b-birds actually eat th-this?
Column11 SCH: 我、我开始思、思考自、自己在这里卖的东、东西。这、这一切是为、为了什么？鸟、鸟真的吃、吃这个吗？
Column12: Gar! That's a fish too, snapper. I'd give ye a fishing metaphor but I'm all outta bait.
Column12 SCH: 嘎！鸭子叫也是这个动静。想拿钓鱼给你打个比方，可是灵感怎么都不上钩。
Column13: All these insults I've thought up are wasted now that I've decided I like people. Need someone new to dislike. That'll be $price
Column13 SCH: 我现在觉得自己喜欢大家了，之前想的骂猫话全都浪费了。需要再找个让我讨厌的猫。$price。

Column2: If you do what you love, you'll never work a day in your life. That's why I'm unemployed.
Column2 SCH: 假如你热爱自己所做的事，那么你一辈子都不是在工作。我就是这样失业的。
Column3: Do you think the weather will ever get better? I noticed the EasyCo factories aren't running anymore, and since they stopped things have been less grey.
Column3 SCH: 你觉得天气会变好吗？我看顺易集团的工厂停了，他们停工之后，天上就没以前那么灰暗了。
Column4: I think about whether I deserve the love I found. But is it worth even wondering? I spent my life being sad about everything, and I wasted all that time.
Column4 SCH: 我在想自己配不配得上我心爱的猫。不过，这种事情值得思考吗？我活到现在，每天都在感伤，浪费了太多时间。
Column5: Fortino and I get to talk all night long. Having someone to listen to me is so special, I didn't know I had so many secrets!
Column5 SCH: 阿肆和我可以聊整整一夜。有猫听我倾诉，这种感觉太特别了，我都不知道自己有那么多秘密！
Column6: Are you Pluto? Because I would deliberate for a long time before calling you a planet.
Column6 SCH: 你是冥王星吗？因为我需要端详很久，才能确定你是不是行星。
Column7: I keep forgetting, I've been meaning to give you my first edition EasyCo driver's handbook! Vintage! That's back when they made paper copies of things.
Column7 SCH: 我一直想把自己第一版顺易集团司机手册给你，结果总是忘！这可是古董！当时还是纸质书。
Column8: Have you seen your car keys?! I keep forgetting to give them back to you. Surely you can drive without them, right?
Column8 SCH: 看到你的车钥匙了没？！我老是忘还给你。你没钥匙肯定也能开车吧？
Column9: I've begun to accept some risk in my life. For example, I put two sugars in my coffee today. That's a big one.
Column9 SCH: 我已经开始接受生活的一些风险了。比如，我今天喝咖啡放了两块糖，这可是个大风险。
Column10: Alright, picture this... A money-printing machine. A machine that prints money! It'll make you rich!
Column10 SCH: 好，想象一下这个……一台印钱机，能印钱的机器！有了这个，你就发财了！
Column11: S-so much harder to f-fly from the ground than f-fall from the s-s-sky, d-don't you think?
Column11 SCH: 在、在地上飞起来比、比从天上掉、掉下来要难、难多了，你、你不觉得吗？
Column12: Are they paying ye enough, minnow? Fuel is bleedin' costly these days.
Column12 SCH: 小家伙，他们给你的工资够用的吗？现在油贵得要命。
Column13: When you're free next, I need one thousand ducks and some laser pointers on straps. Duck sized. Anyway, $price
Column13 SCH: 下次有空的时候，给我带一千只鸭子和一批有带子的激光笔，大小要和鸭子差不多。$price。

Column2: Even if you weren't, I'd tell you you're so good at your job.
Column2 SCH: 就算你工作干得不好，我也会说你工作干得很好。
Column3: I'm glad I have friends to reassure me these days. Who would have known all I needed to begin to trust myself was a few nights with good people around a campfire.
Column3 SCH: 我很庆幸自己现在有朋友安慰我。谁能想到，我真正需要的，根本就只是和善良的猫一起，围着营火度过几个晚上。
Column4: Life is good. I spend my time with people I love. I still can't help but get sad sometimes, but now I have reasons to cheer up.
Column4 SCH: 生活是美好的。我和心爱的猫在一起。我有时还是会不由自主地难过，可现在有了开心的理由。
Column5: I could have sworn I saw a star last night! Two of them, so close to the ground, on the road! And then your truck drove right past me. Amazing!
Column5 SCH: 我昨晚真的看到星星了！有两颗，离地面特别近，在路上的时候！然后你的卡车就从我眼前开过去了。太神奇了！
Column6: If you were a delivery driver and I was a random NPC you picked up packages from, I'd tell you sweet nothings every time you visited.
Column6 SCH: 如果你是快递司机，而我是你取货的路人NPC，那么你每次来，我都会对你说一些无聊的甜言蜜语。
Column7: I believe I almost saw the sun just the other day. It already feels warmer, I say.
Column7 SCH: 我那天应该是差点就看到太阳了，毕竟天气暖和起来了。
Column8: I once went three days without remembering it was Tuesday. By the time I remembered, it was Tuesday again. Isn't that funny.
Column8 SCH: 我有一次连着三天都忘了那天是星期二。等我想起来的时候，又是星期二了。是不是很搞笑。
Column9: I made the mistake of betting Sixo wouldn't drink ten EZ-Energy drinks in a row.
Column9 SCH: 我打赌小陆不能连喝十罐顺易能量饮料，结果我赌错了。
Column10: Look, I know my twin hates my ideas. But they still support them every time. Lame!
Column10 SCH: 我知道我哥不喜欢我这些点子，可他每次都还是支持我。真逊！
Column11: W-we l-love having you ar-r-round again.
Column11 SCH: 你、你回来了，我、我们很、很高兴。
Column12: It's a good day, mooneye. Havnae spoken to anyone at all. Glorious. Well, except ye now. Time tae go, then.
Column12 SCH: 今天天气不错。谁都没跟我说过话。好极了，哦，除了你。该走了。
Column13: There's a problem with my unlimited duck strategy for taking over the world. I have never seen a duck in my life. Gimme $price
Column13 SCH: 我想用无限量的鸭子统治世界，只是这个策略有个问题，就是我还没见过鸭子。给我$price。

Column2: Everything I see, I can't help but enjoy. Except unkindness! When I see that, I intervene reasonably.
Column2 SCH: 我不论看到什么，都会情不自禁去欣赏。当然除了恶意！我看到恶意的时候，会合理加以干预。
Column3: I've been learning to trust that people are telling me the truth, maybe for the first time in my life. Foreman told me they liked going fishing with Tooey and I, and I really believe it.
Column3 SCH: 我现在知道怎样可以相信大家，接受大家说的话，可能是我活到现在第一次。佛尔曼说他喜欢跟我和图伊去钓鱼，我相信他说的是实话。
Column4: Do you know what an aurora is? Tooey has been telling Ellie and I all about them. Floating waves in the sky, blue and green and ethereal magic.
Column4 SCH: 你知道极光是什么东西吗？图伊最近经常跟我和艾丽提到这个。说是飘在天上的波浪，有蓝有绿，很玄乎的魔法。
Column5: Seen any ghosts lately? Fortino and I once saw one buy an EZ-Energy drink from the vending machine and then get in a truck. Spooky.
Column5 SCH: 最近见过鬼魂没有？阿肆和我之前见过一哥们儿，在自动贩卖机那儿买了能量饮料之后，就上了卡车，吓猫。
Column6: If you were Mars and I was the Curiosity rover, I'd be content to eplore your heavenly body forever.
Column6 SCH: 假如你是火星，我是好奇号，那我一定愿意一辈子不断探索你的天体。
Column7: Tell old Foreman to smarten up next time you see 'em. Old codfish. Heh-heh.
Column7 SCH: 下次碰见老佛尔曼，让他机灵一点。个老糊涂，咳咳。
Column8: I think your alternator fell out. Don't worry, it'll fix itself.
Column8 SCH: 你卡车的发电机应该是有问题。不用担心，它自己能恢复正常。
Column9: I guess I do need to accept that life comes with risk. Is that what makes life fun? It's so easy to just sit in some blankets, man.
Column9 SCH: 生活本身必然有风险，我可能需要接受这个现实。不就是风险让生活变得有意思？裹着毯子空坐着的话，还有什么意思？
Column10: If I put half my money into EasyCoin and the other half into EasyBank, I'll never lose a cent. It's that simple!
Column10 SCH: 如果假如我把一半的钱放进顺易金融，一半放进顺易银行，就一分钱都不会亏了。小菜一碟！
Column11: M-maybe even if flaws m-m-make people human, they are still g-good things, because being human is g-good.
Column11 SCH: 既、既然缺点才是人之为、为人的原因、那缺、缺点也是好东西，因为能够做人是件好事。
Column12: Now that the minnows all gather and talk, callin themselves some sortae friends, I've got no time to meself. But isn't it a wee bit sweet to bum around with old Tooey.
Column12 SCH: 现在这帮小鱼小虾成天凑在一起聊天，说他们是什么朋友，弄得我也没办法自己清净了。不过能见到老图伊，也挺有意思。
Column13: I'm speaking directly to you. YOU, the player! That's right. I know you're there. How many ducks do you have access to? That'll be $price
Column13 SCH: 我在跟你说话，就是你，玩家！对。我知道你在那儿。你找到多少只鸭子了？$price。

Column2: You don't have a favourite 17th century Celtic poet?
Column2 SCH: 17世纪的凯尔特诗人就没有哪个你最喜欢的吗？
Column3: There are so many bad things that happen in the world, even to me. But I've decided those things shouldn't make me mistrust that good things still happen.
Column3 SCH: 世界上发生了那么多坏事，有些甚至就发生在我身上，可我现在明白了，虽然遭遇了那些事，我还是应该相信美好的事情依然会发生。
Column4: Ellie and I have been going out late and hunting for stars. One day soon, we'll find one! I can feel it.
Column4 SCH: 艾丽和我最近晚上经常出去找星星。我有预感，我们最近肯定就能找到一颗！
Column5: Sometimes, Fortino and I look at the radio towers and imagine the blinking light is the sun pushing through. Other times, I pretend it's a laser pointer that I can catch!
Column5 SCH: 有时候，阿肆和我会望着无线电塔，把闪烁的光想成穿透云层的阳光。还有的时候，我会把它当成我能抓住的激光笔！
Column6: There's a gentle peace in the chill of the wind, a calm in the soot-coated snow. Maybe we are insignificant. Maybe we are the most important beings in the universe.
Column6 SCH: 寒风有一种温柔的平静，煤烟覆盖的雪中有一种安宁。也许我们微不足道。也许我们是宇宙中最重要的存在。
Column7: Gee, it's gotta be awful tiring doing this day-in, day-out. Have a fourteen-hour nap! Hits the spot for me every time.
Column7 SCH: 啊呀，天天干这个肯定很累吧。睡个十四小时的觉吧！我每次睡完都是精神焕发。
Column8: It's so nice that you've never actually asked me to fix your truck. I'm not sure I'd have enough time to do it, as you can see I'm very busy.
Column8 SCH: 幸好你从来没让我帮你修过卡车。就算你让我帮忙，我都不知道自己有没有时间，你也看见了，我忙得要命。
Column9: I had Sixo on my team for trivia night. I've gotta say, I was impressed. The category was "con artists". I don't think I'll read into that.
Column9 SCH: 我知识问答之夜的队友是小陆。不得不说，我没想到他那么厉害，我们选的话题是“骗子”。这个事情我应该不会多想。
Column10: What's life without a little risk? I say gambling everything you own on a food truck that promises to make you smarter is what makes life interesting.
Column10 SCH: 生活没有一点风险的话，还算什么生活？要我说，把自己拥有的一切都赌在一辆餐车上，然后希望它能让你生活更潇洒，这才是生活的有趣之所在。
Column11: I am s-so impressed with the w-way you d-d-drive the truck. I am t-too afraid of heights to drive. And f-falling from them.
Column11 SCH: 你开、开车让我印、印象深刻。我特、特别怕高，不、不敢开卡车，也、也怕从车上掉、掉下来。
Column12: Carry on, goby. And tell old Tooey they're a clownfish next time ye see 'em.
Column12 SCH: 小家伙，继续加油。下次见到老图伊，跟他说他就是条小丑鱼。
Column13: Listen, good buddy, I've given up on the ducks world domination idea. Wink, wink. Anyway, hypothetically, where would I be able to buy bulk duck food? That's $price
Column13 SCH: 好朋友，我跟你说，我已经不准备用鸭子统治世界了。眨眼，眨眼。再说了，假设我要用鸭子统治世界，又去哪儿能买到那么多鸭饲料？总共$price。

Column2: I'd suggest my favourite Ethiopian jazz album to you, but unfortunately it's an impossible-to-find underground recording of a gig with three people in the audience.
Column2 SCH: 我本来想跟你推荐我最喜欢的埃塞俄比亚爵士专辑，可惜那个是盗录，现场只有三个观众，根本找不到录音。
Column3: Ellie, Fortino, Ada and I have been out hunting for something they call an aurora. I don't know what that is, I'm just happy people want to do things with me.
Column3 SCH: 艾丽、阿肆、阿达和我一直在找他们说的那个极光。我也不知道是什么，只是高兴有猫愿意和我一起做事情。
Column4: If you're ever sad, I've learned, you can be happy at the same time. Process more than one emotion at once. It makes each emotion that much stronger but I've found the good ones do win out eventually.
Column4 SCH: 我现在明白了，就算难过的时候，也可以同时感到开心。同时处理多种情绪，这样会让每种情绪都更强烈，不过我发现最后都是好情绪压住坏情绪。
Column5: Have you ever seen a lollipop? What I wouldn't give to be holding a lollipop right about now!
Column5 SCH: 你见过棒棒糖吗？我现在好像有一根棒棒糖啊！
Column6: Back when the roads were good, I'd have taken you for a drive through the countryside. Maybe someday they'll be nice again.
Column6 SCH: 换了以前路况好的时候，我肯定带你去乡下兜风。说不定路况以后还能再变好。
Column7: Give old Foreman a snowball when you see them next. Say it'll warm that cold heart of theirs! Heh-heh.
Column7 SCH: 下次见到老佛尔曼，砸他个雪球。就说这能温暖他那颗冰冷的心！嘿嘿。
Column8: Still all out of air for your tires. Try blowing really hard on them.
Column8 SCH: 还是没气给你的轮胎，用力吹几口试试。
Column9: I'm so happy you hear out all my twin's ideas, as silly as they might be. They really appreciate it.
Column9 SCH: 小陆的那些点子，你全都听他说了一遍。虽然有的很荒唐，但他很感激。
Column10: I'm telling you, all you need to do is get a robot to sleep for you. Think of the possibilities! You could finally work more!
Column10 SCH: 我告诉你，你只要能找个机器猫替你睡觉，那该多好！你就能多工作了！
Column11: I l-love spending more t-time with my friends. T-today we will have c-c-coffee! I d-drink decaf.
Column11 SCH: 我、我喜欢和、和朋友待、待在一天。我、我们今天喝、喝咖、咖啡！我、我喝无因的。
Column12: If that wee truck had a voice, mackerel... It'd tell ye to go fishing.
Column12 SCH: 假如那辆小卡车能说话……肯定会叫你去钓鱼。
Column13: Uh... If you see any rogue laser ducks running around the streets, just ignore them. Quick, give me $price
Column13 SCH: 哎……如果你在路上看到了流窜的激光鸭，不用理它们。快，给我$price。

Column2: Remember, virtue is its own reward.
Column2 SCH: 记住，美德本身就是回报。
Column3: Every night, all of us go search for the aurora. All of us know, deep down, that we don't ever need to find it. We just love our time together. What are you searching for?
Column3 SCH: 我们每天晚上全都会去找极光。我们心底里都知道我们不是需要找到极光，而是享受在一起的时光。你在寻找什么？
Column4: I feel like it's getting warmer outside every day. Maybe it's just how I feel inside, but I don't care.
Column4 SCH: 感觉外面一天比一天暖和。也许只是我在室内的感觉，但我无所谓。
Column5: Sweet, sweet Fortino is so good to me. They found a whole box of lollipops at the fuel station for me! I think magic is real.
Column5 SCH: 亲爱的阿肆对我太好了。他在加油站给我找到了整整一箱棒棒糖！我现在相信世上真的有魔法。
Column6: It's peaceful, searching for love on my own. Perhaps knowing myself fully is the most precious love one can find. On the other hand... My God, you look good today.
Column6 SCH: 独自寻找爱情令我内心平和。或许完全了解自己，这件事情就是最珍贵的爱情。话说回来……上帝啊，你今天状态看起来很好。
Column7: Have you finally seen a sunrise yet, whippersnapper? Most beautiful thing the world has ever known.
Column7 SCH: 年轻人，终于看到日出了吗？那是世界上最美的东西。
Column8: If your car starts making noises that sound out of the ordinary, just turn your music up louder. Problem solved!
Column8 SCH: 假如车子出现异常声音，就把音乐声音开大。问题就解决了！
Column9: I'm living boldly! Unapologetic! Today I looked only TWICE before crossing the street.
Column9 SCH: 我活得肆意！无拘无束！今天过马路前只看了两眼。
Column10: What if... Nope, actually, nevermind. You wouldn't understand. I'm operating on a higher level, you know.
Column10 SCH: 假如……算了，你也不懂。你知道的，我的境界比较高。
Column11: It is n-not so c-c-cold when you are here.
Column11 SCH: 你、你来了就没那么冷、冷了。
Column12: Next time you see Tooey, snapper, donnae say anything. Tooey will know it's from me.
Column12 SCH: 年轻人，下次见图伊，啥都不用说。他就知道是我让你去的。
Column13: I think the duck situation is under control. If you hear a quack, it's your imagination. $price, please.
Column13 SCH: 我感觉鸭子的情况已经控制住了。你要是听到嘎嘎声，那就是你幻觉了。请付$price。
